The Psychedelic Furs are an English rock band founded in London in February 1977.
Led by lead vocalist Richard Butler and his brother Tim Butler on bass guitar, the Psychedelic Furs are one of the many acts spawned from the British post-punk scene.
The band had several hits in their early career.
The discography of the English rock band the Psychedelic Furs consists of eight studio albums, 22 singles, six compilation albums, and two live albums.
The Psychedelic Furs formed in 1977 and released their eponymous debut studio album in 1980.
It reached number 18 on the UK Albums Chart and number 140 on the US Billboard 200.
